title: RecapPVP
description: This is a new way to track progression throughout training PVP! Track your pvp stats your way!
body:
# RecapPvP

**RecapPvP** is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21 that tracks and displays a detailed breakdown of your PvP performance after every fight — so you can learn, improve, and review your gameplay with ease.

---

## 🗡️ What Does It Do?

Whenever you're in a PvP fight, RecapPvP silently records everything happening in the background. When the fight ends, it prints a clean **PVP Recap** summary showing everything that mattered.

No more guessing how many potions you burned, whether your sword accuracy was on point, or how many pearls you wasted — RecapPvP tells you exactly.

---

## 📊 Tracked Stats

RecapPvP tracks a wide range of combat statistics, all configurable:

- **Kills & Deaths** — K/D ratio per session
- **Sword Stats** — Hits and misses
- **Mace Stats** — Hits and misses
- **Shield Breaks** — Shields you disabled vs. shields the opponent disabled on you
- **Potions** — Health pots and buff pots used
- **Consumables** — Food, golden apples, XP bottles
- **Utilities** — Crystals placed, anchors placed, cobwebs, wind charges
- **Pearls Used**
- **Elytra Distance** — How far you flew during the fight
- **Live Combo & Reach Display** — See your current combo and reach in real time during combat
- **Potion Alerts** — Get warned when a potion is about to expire

---

## 💾 Battle History

Loved a session? Save it. RecapPvP includes a full **Battle History** system — name your battles and store them locally. View or replay any past session from the in-game History screen.

---

## 🎉 Auto-GG

RecapPvP can automatically send a **GG message** to chat at the end of a fight, chosen randomly from a set of friendly messages. Toggle it on or off whenever you like.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Everything is configurable through the in-game **Config Screen**. Enable or disable any stat category to keep your recap focused on what matters to you:

- Show/hide pearls, shield breaks, mace stats, sword stats, consumables, potions, utilities, movement, combo, reach, potion alerts, and Auto-GG

---

## 🎮 Key Bindings

| Binding | Default | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Toggle Recording | Unbound | Start/stop tracking |
| Open Recap Menu | Unbound | View current session stats |
| Open History | Unbound | Browse saved battles |

You can also use the `/recapsave` command to save a battle directly from chat.

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) ≥ 0.19.2
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

---

*Client-side only — works on any server.*
